About this Event

Use Hindi to open doors of success and invest in self-development
Who is training?
Pooja Chandna is an experienced online Hindi language coach with experience of teaching Hindi to international students interested in beginning to advanced level Hindi.

Please follow above page for more upcoming sessions and classes or for tips on learning Hindi.

Why learn Hindi in a structured way?
Hindi is 3rd largest spoken language in the world with 615 million speakers. Work on certification in Hindi to help with college admissions or pursue other goals. Trainer for the course, Pooja Chandna, has a background in psychology and dramatics and has stayed in multiple countries. The course will be structured in such a way that you will get more than just learn a language. You learn listening, speaking, reading and writing. Beyond that, you also learn the Indian way of solving problems, working out relations and seeking contentment and joy in the simplicity of life.

What is the goal of this free class?
The first class is to help you discover your interest in the Hindi language, ability to commit to it and evaluate the trainer's pedagogical capability. Also, if you are returning to India and need your kid to be ready to study in India, you can get tips in this class. If you like the class and would like to sign up for private paid lessons, you can let the trainer, Pooja, know. The timing and price will be shared after the class.

How does trainer Pooja make learning Hindi structured & enjoyable?
Use games and activities to learn new vocabulary, recognise words and more importantly, feel it in your heart. You learn, without even realising it.
